name: Enemy Posture System PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. Enemy Posture System 0.9.0 (LNK01): everything of 0.8.2 (Bokoblin posture, no stagger below 100, break/punish/Finish, enemy posture bars, Shield Attack parry +40) PLUS Link's own posture: a large bar centred at the bottom of the screen fills +20 for every REAL ordinary shield block of a Bokoblin blow (parries give Link +0), recovers 10 points/s after 1 s without blocks and fades out at 0. The bottom-centre action-button prompts (icons, action texts and their sparkles) are hidden visually; every button and action keeps working, floating messages stay. Reaching 100 is visual only in this build: no new guard break or damage (the game's own guard break is unchanged). Replaces 0.8.2 and older versions of this mod (same ID): never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
